_doc: Shared test vectors for the binding expression language (Site Code phase 3). Go (backend/internal/design) and TypeScript (frontend editor) MUST both pass every case. 'ctx' is the evaluation context; 'out' is the rendered string (null/undefined render as empty string). 'error': true means the expression must be rejected at parse time (the template keeps the raw text and the editor shows an error).

cases.expr: item.stock == 0 ? 'หมด' : 'มีสินค้า'

_notes: Numbers: numeric strings (e.g. DECIMAL '215.25') are converted to numbers for arithmetic and comparison; results are printed with up to 10 significant decimals and no trailing zeros (645.75, 2.5), integers without '.0'.
'+' concatenates when either side is a non-numeric string; otherwise adds.
Division/modulo by zero, arithmetic with null/undefined → null (renders '').
Booleans render 'true'/'false'. Arrays/objects render as JSON only through | json; otherwise ''.
Unknown formatter: value passed through unchanged (server logs a warning; editor shows a small marker). Formatters registered by scripts (site.formatter) run server-side only.

date formatter tokens: D DD M MM MMM MMMM YY YYYY BBBB(Buddhist year) H HH m mm; month names follow site.language when it is 'th' (ม.ค., มกราคม) — the vectors above use 'en' month names because the evaluator gets locale 'en' in tests; implement th names too and test them separately. Dates are formatted in the site timezone; tests use UTC.
Paths never resolve __proto__, constructor, prototype (→ null). Only identifier paths with '.'; no indexing, no calls, no assignment.
Output is HTML-escaped by the renderer AFTER evaluation (the vectors show raw strings).

visitor (phase 4a): the site.visitor result {id, name, groups, ...} or null. visitor.is.<group> is true/false by membership of <group> in visitor.groups (false when visitor is null or has no groups; never null); visitor.is.<group>.<more> is null; 'is' is reserved: visitor.is alone is null; visitor.is.__proto__ (and constructor, prototype) is null; non-array groups give false. See also expr_vectors_visitor.json (shared with the editor).
